  i) circuit current

3)        Two circuits, the impedances of which are given by Z1 = (15 + j12) ohms and Z2 = (8 + j5) ohms         (5)  
  are connected in parallel. If the potential difference across one of the impedances is (250 + j0) V,  
  A)   calculate  
  (i) total current and branch currents  
  (ii) total power and power consumed in each branch and  
  (iii) overall power-factor  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)   Two-wattmeter method is used to determine the input power to a three-phase motor. The readings         (5)  
  of the meters are 5.2 kW and -1.7 kW, and the line voltage is 415 V. Calculate  
  (a) the total power,  
  (b) the power factor, and  
  (c) the line current.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)        A balanced star connected load of (8+j6) Ω per phase is connected to a 3 φ, 230 Volts, 50 Hz, AC       (6)  
  supply. Find  
  A)   i) Line current  
  ii) Power factor  
  iii) Power  
  Page #2

iv) Total reactive Power  
  v) Total Volt-Amp  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)               An iron ring of cross-sectional area 6 cm 2 is wound with a wire of 100 turns and has a saw cut of 2    (4)  
  mm. Calculate the magnetising current required to produce a flux of 0·1 mWb if mean length of  
  magnetic path is 30 cm and relative permeability of iron is 470.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                       A cast steel electromagnet has an air gap length of 3 mm and an iron path of length 40 cm. Find the (3)  
  number of ampere-turns necessary to produce a flux density of 0.7 Wb/m2 in the gap. Neglect  
  A)               leakage and fringing. Assume ampere-turns required for air gap to be 70% of the total ampere-  
  turns.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)               Explain the construction of single-phase induction motor.                                               (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)               Explain the working of single-phase digital energy meter with a neat diagram.                           (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
